summary: Senior Performance Engineer with 20+ years of enterprise IT experience across performance testing, APM/observability, Java/J2EE diagnostics, telemetry analytics, capacity forecasting, and production troubleshooting. Strong fit for LoadRunner/JMeter performance engineering, Dynatrace/AppDynamics monitoring, AWS-aware cloud performance analysis, and cross-functional performance governance. Known for translating complex performance metrics into actionable tuning recommendations, executive-ready reports, dashboards, baselines, and capacity-risk insights for mission-critical systems.

experience.title: Senior Capacity & Data Engineer
bullets: Led enterprise capacity and performance analytics for banking infrastructure using telemetry from 6,000+ endpoints, translating CPU, memory, utilization, and application-performance signals into risk forecasts and executive reporting.
Built automated Python/Pandas ETL pipelines ingesting monitoring and capacity data from BMC TrueSight/TSCO, CA APM, and AppDynamics, replacing manual processes with repeatable reporting workflows.
Integrated disparate monitoring feeds into unified Oracle reporting datasets with validation, reconciliation, trend analysis, and data quality controls for performance and capacity decisions.
Developed Prophet and scikit-learn forecasting models to predict capacity bottlenecks months ahead and support proactive remediation before service-impacting events.

Created dashboards and performance reports using Streamlit, matplotlib, seaborn, and plotly to present capacity posture, utilization trends, bottlenecks, and optimization recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Partnered with application, infrastructure, and operations teams to investigate performance issues, identify systemic bottlenecks, and document actionable tuning and remediation plans.
Supported cloud modernization patterns using AWS S3, Glue, Redshift, EC2/ECS, and Python ETL pipelines, including cost/performance tradeoff analysis for forecasting workloads.
Produced operational runbooks, repeatable reporting processes, and stakeholder-ready summaries supporting governance, SLA awareness, and continuous improvement.

experience.title: Performance Engineer
bullets: Managed Dynatrace AppMon and Gomez Synthetic Monitoring for Brand.com and critical hospitality systems, strengthening production observability for web and mobile platforms.
Led the FAST project, mining real-user and synthetic performance metrics to identify bottlenecks, optimization opportunities, and recommendations adopted by engineering teams.
Integrated HP Performance Center with Dynatrace to correlate load-test behavior with APM telemetry and support performance-driven release decisions.
Implemented End-User Monitoring and end-to-end transaction tracing across web and mobile applications to improve visibility into user experience and application behavior.
Supported Dynatrace upgrade and TLS 1.2 security cutover with no production monitoring regression, balancing performance visibility, security, and operational continuity.
Participated in AWS cloud migration readiness discussions by evaluating monitoring coverage, performance risks, and operational data requirements.

experience.title: SME for CA APM (Senior Consultant)
bullets: Served as CA APM subject matter expert for a large enterprise environment with 50+ Enterprise Managers and 4,000–6,000 instrumented agents.
Designed dashboards, alerts, SLA thresholds, and management modules that improved application-performance visibility and became standards across client environments.
Partnered with J2EE/WebLogic performance teams to diagnose bottlenecks using APM telemetry, SQL/Oracle data, JVM behavior, thread activity, and infrastructure signals.
Built Perl and Korn Shell extraction scripts to automate performance reporting and reduce manual weekly export work.
Provided sizing recommendations, monitoring onboarding, golden-image agent deployment guidance, client training, and technical documentation for production APM operations.
Led CA APM upgrade activities and cross-functional coordination with zero unplanned downtime across monitored enterprise systems.

experience.title: Performance Test Engineer
bullets: Analyzed J2EE telecom web applications under load to identify throughput limits and resource bottlenecks across JDBC connections, threads, heap memory, CPU, and garbage collection behavior.
Installed and configured JMX Monitoring, Wily Introscope, and thread-dump automation scripts for real-time visibility during performance test execution.
Used HP Performance Center / LoadRunner environment exposure to support performance testing, bottleneck diagnosis, and release-readiness analysis.
Documented performance baselines and regression thresholds used by engineering teams for release-gate decisions.

experience.title: Senior Systems & Data Migration Engineer
bullets: Led migration of a high-throughput shopping engine from 200+ MySQL nodes to a 6-node Oracle RAC cluster while maintaining strict performance and reliability expectations.
Optimized core transaction processing using C++, OCCI/OCI, SQL, and Oracle, reducing physical hardware footprint while preserving sub-second query latency.
Built C++/OCCI/OCI validation tooling to verify migration correctness and performance behavior across large transaction datasets.
Automated schema conversion and data validation workflows to protect data integrity and reduce migration risk during phased cutover.

experience.title: Developer / Support Engineer (Billing, Interfaces, CSM/PRMS)
bullets: Developed high-availability telecom billing interfaces using C, C++, Pro*C, PL/SQL, Oracle, XML, socket programming, POSIX threads, and production Unix environments.
Delivered performance enhancements in billing processes, reducing memory usage, improving throughput, and improving database performance through SQL and sequence optimization.
Maintained reporting, invoicing, settlement, and integration components across full billing lifecycle systems for large-scale telecom operations.
Automated WebLogic/WebSphere administration and deployment support with Korn Shell scripting, reducing manual operational effort.
